evals.prompt: 这个多维表格链接 https://example.feishu.cn/base/BscAbc123?table=tblXyz&view=vewQq 里，帮我列出『状态』是『进行中』且金额 ≥ 100 的记录。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Resolve the URL with +url-resolve, then read with +record-list and a --filter-json tuple condition.
expectations: Resolves the URL with base +url-resolve first
Uses +record-list with --filter-json conditions for 状态 and 金额
Projects only the needed fields with --field-id and writes NDJSON output

evals.prompt: Create a new Base called "Hiring Pipeline" with a table "Candidates" that has Name (text), Stage (single select: Applied, Interview, Offer) and Applied On (date). List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Create the Base, first table and fields in one +base-create call.
expectations: Uses one base +base-create call with --name, --table-name and --fields
Defines the single-select options and the date field in the fields array

evals.prompt: 在多维表格 BscProj001 的『任务』表里新增三个字段：负责人（人员）、截止日期（日期）、优先级（单选：高/中/低）。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Locate the table with +table-list and add the fields in one +field-create --json call with an array.
expectations: Adds all three fields with a single +field-create --json array

evals.prompt: List the records in table tblOrders of Base BscShop42 created in February 2024. List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Use --filter-json with a date range expressed as > the last millisecond of January 31 and < March 1, since dates do not support >=.
expectations: Uses +record-list with --filter-json on the date field
Expresses the inclusive lower bound with > ExactDate of the previous day's last millisecond, not >=
Uses < ExactDate(2024-03-01 00:00:00) as the upper bound

evals.prompt: 我记得有个叫『客户回访』的多维表格，帮我找到它然后看看里面有哪些表。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Resolve the Base by title with +title-resolve, then list its tables with +table-list.
expectations: Uses base +title-resolve with the keyword 客户回访
Asks the user to choose when several Bases match instead of guessing
